title: Temporal persistence as a benchmark for reservoir-associated flow-duration alteration: code and results
description: Version 2.0.0 provides the revised chronological and main-basin benchmark, saved predictions, fixed-cohort source comparisons, gap sensitivities, failure-warning experiments and figure sources in hsj_revision/. Saved-result verification is included; a fresh-input clean-environment rerun has not been completed. Historical files outside hsj_revision/ belong to the earlier workflow. Raw flow archives and BasinATLAS polygons are not redistributed.
